## Plan / implementation

- `crates/hh-verification/src/bind.rs` — `EffectStateRow.
  postcondition_results` lifted off the terminal `observed` row
  (absent ⇒ `[]`, additive never fabricated); `bind_claim` binds a
  declared-postcondition verdict when the claim names the effect
  (`subject = effect{…}` or an `effect:`-prefixed evidence ref) —
  D1.
- `crates/hh-verification/src/claims.rs` — `(ClaimKind::Achieved,
  HandleValue::Verdict{!affirmative})` joins `claim_contradicted` and
  maps to `DivergenceClass::UnverifiedVerification` — a declared
  postcondition/`diff_sanity` failure on cited evidence contradicts
  the claim.
- `crates/hh-verification/src/validators.rs` — `declaration_json(d)`:
  the one canonical render of `ValidatorDeclaration` (the `declare`
  contract doc the OOP lane serves — D5) +
  `declaration_json_carries_the_full_declaration` (schema-drift guard).
- `crates/hh-verification/src/belief_probe.rs` — `ProbeRule` decode off
  `ProfileRule{kind = belief_probe}` (missing assumption debt → typed
  `ProbeRuleError`, never a silent skip), `elicit` over the recorded
  args, `probe_id`/`fire` minting the durable `BeliefProbeRecord`
  (`provisional: true` constitutive; judged rules declared, never
  fired by the deterministic emitter).
- `crates/hh-control/src/driver.rs` — `belief_probe_rules` decoded at
  `open`/`resume` (`DriverError::MalformedProfileRule` on a debtless
  rule); `emit_belief_probes` after `model.call.completed` over
  recorded `calls[].args_raw`; `resolve_belief_subject` — `effect:`/
  `call:`/`verdict:` spellings resolve durable *rows*
  (`row:<event_id>`), `call:` two-hops through
  `intent.tool_call_id` since the model never knows the kernel's
  `ef-N` (D2); `emit_computed_metrics` at `finish` — `evalfold::
  compute` over the prefix → typed `MetricValue` rows (`n/a{reason}`
  first-class) appended before `run.finished` (D4).
- `crates/hh-control/src/loops.rs` — `RecordedJudge`: the offline
  `JudgePort` over recorded `detector = judged` verdict rows;
  unrecorded refs abstain (D3); wired through `DriverConfig.judge` →
  `guards::detect_with_judge` (the `stop` clamp stands).
- `crates/hh-plugin-fixture` — the `validator` mode: `declare`/`bind`/
  `collect`/`check` over `plugin_abi/1` running the real
  `hh-verification` semantics (CC1/CC7 — never a re-spelling);
  `--validator-side-effects`/`--validator-empty-evidence` doctor the
  canned declaration so the suite's negative arms hit
  `ValidatorHasEffects`/`IncompleteDeclaration` for real; contract
  failures answer typed in-band docs, never `op_failed`.
- `crates/hh-varhost/tests/validator_conformance.rs` — the class
  conformance battery (9 cells).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0347` — the five owned rulings.

## Test matrix

| AC / behaviour | test |
|---|---|
| postcondition verdict binds through the cited effect | `bind::tests::postcondition_verdicts_bind_through_the_cited_effect` |
| a passing postcondition produces no divergence | `bind::tests::postcondition_pass_does_not_diverge` |
| `achieved` + non-affirmative verdict ⇒ `unverified_verification` | `claims.rs` arm, exercised by the bind pair |
| belief-probe rules decode; debtless rule refuses | `belief_probe::tests::probe_rules_*` (3 cells) |
| elicitation reads declared items, skips malformed | `belief_probe::tests::elicit_reads_declared_items_and_skips_malformed` |
| divergence only on a resolved mismatch | `belief_probe::tests::fire_marks_divergence_only_on_a_resolved_mismatch` |
| `provisional` constitutive on the record | `belief_probe::tests::record_round_trips_and_provisional_is_constitutive` |
| judged/deterministic strata never merge | `belief_probe::tests::divergence_folds_per_detector_never_merged` |
| runtime emission over recorded model_io; unresolved ⇒ no comparison | `driver::tests::belief_probe_rules_emit_rows_over_recorded_model_io` |
| debtless rule refuses `open` typed | `driver::tests::a_debtless_belief_probe_rule_refuses_open` |
| `judged` probe rules declared, never fired | `driver::tests::a_judged_probe_rule_is_declared_not_fired` |
| computed metrics emit before `run.finished` | `driver::tests::a_finished_run_emits_computed_metrics` |
| recorded-judge replay + abstention | `loops::tests::recorded_judge_replays_and_abstains` |
| `declare` doc carries the full declaration | `validators::tests::declaration_json_carries_the_full_declaration` |
| OOP suite — declare/bind/collect/check + negative arms | `hh-varhost/tests/validator_conformance.rs` (9 cells) |
